findings.finding: Q3 core earnings and cash flow were pre-warned as significantly negative on 2026-10-02 (FY volume and cash-flow outlooks withdrawn), so the reported quarter's weakness is already public and the stock fell 7.35% that day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last pre-warning (2 Oct) moved the stock -7.35%. Report days: Q1 2026 gapped +6.0% on an EBIT beat (1.6bn vs ~0.9bn expected) and closed -3.9%; Q2 2026 -10.8%; Q4 2025 -22.5%; Q3 2025 +38.1% on a beat from a depressed base (tape: query1.finance.yahoo.com chart VOLCAR-B.ST)
findings.original_quote: Denna utveckling kommer att ha en betydande negativ påverkan på resultatet för kärnverksamheten och kassaflödet under det tredje kvartalet ... Volvo Cars [har] även beslutat att inte lämna något uppdaterat kortsiktigt framåtblickande uttalande. (This development will have a significant negative impact on core earnings and cash flow in Q3 ... Volvo Cars has also decided not to provide any updated short-term forward-looking statement.)
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the stock fell 7.35% on the warning day and is at its lowest since the 2021 listing. What remains unpriced is only the size behind the word 'significant', which no source quantifies, so this sits near 0.
findings.independence: The pre-close call of 21 Sep (QTD retail -13%, no positive offsets) points the same way: https://quartr.com/events/volvo-cars-volcar-pre-close-call_ozje0hch

findings.finding: Volvo Cars said it will present 'further decisive actions' to accelerate its strategic roadmap with the Q3 report. This is the one scheduled new item in the release, landing on a stock down 29.8% in 60 days with a hiring freeze for white-collar staff already reported.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cost actions have been the stock's positive catalyst: Q2 2026 reported SEK 5bn savings six months early yet fell 10.8% on the outlook, while Q2 2025 (+7.9%) and Q3 2025 (+38.1%) came after the 2025 cost and headcount programme. Mixed
findings.original_quote: Volvo Cars vidtar ytterligare beslutsamma åtgärder för att förbättra och accelerera genomförandet av vår strategiska färdplan i ett utmanande marknadsläge. Företaget kommer att presentera mer information i samband med rapporten för det tredje kvartalet den 23 oktober. (Volvo Cars is taking further decisive actions ... will present more information with the Q3 report on 23 October.)
findings.why_not_priced: The content is unknown until the release. If the market had already credited a large restructuring, the stock would not have kept making listing lows after the warning; it closed 14.27 on 22 Oct against 14.18 on the warning day. Restructuring charges could hit reported EBIT, so the sign is uncertain and the range is wide.
findings.independence: EFN (2 Oct) expects further belt-tightening and reports a hiring freeze for white-collar staff and new rules on recruitment, consultants and purchased services: https://efn.se/jonathan-axelsson-ett-nytt-forlorat-ar-for-volvo-cars

findings.finding: EX60 output at Torslanda has run at about one-tenth of the ~2,000-a-week plan, with GlobalData-estimated sales of ~500 in July and ~250 in August and US deliveries pushed to H1 2027. Q2 FCF was already SEK -5.2bn on the EX60 inventory build, so Q3 cash flow and the ramp commentary are the likeliest negative surprise lines.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 printed FCF of SEK -5.2bn alongside a 1.1% EBIT margin and the stock fell 10.8% on the day. Cash has been part of the negative report days
findings.why_not_priced: The cash hit was flagged qualitatively but not sized. Handelsbanken called the warning only 'partly expected' and cited the weak EX60 uptake. A tape that had fully priced a deep cash burn would not have bounced 4.4% on 20 Oct. The finding is partly priced, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Handelsbanken's Hampus Engellau (Nyhetsbyrån Direkt, 2 Oct): 'Enligt Hampus Engellau påverkar även ett svagare upptag av den nyare modellen EX60' (weaker EX60 uptake also weighs) https://www.placera.se/telegram/volvo-cars-delvis-vantad-varning-shb-20261002 ; Q2 FCF -5.2bn on EX60 inventory: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bc15220dfd3a2e052ee03705ce161def0&lang=en&src=listed

lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the pre-warned Q3 finding moved from -0.3 to -0.1
'Cash can outweigh': the EX60/FCF finding raised from -0.6 to -0.8 as the likeliest new negative line
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' plus a history of report-day beats being sold (Q1 2026 gapped +6%, closed -3.9%): the actions finding trimmed from +1.0 to +0.8 and p_up from 52 to 50

'The move is in the guide': no guide is expected, but abs_move_pct is kept at 6.5 rather than cut to the 3% pre-released base, because the observed report-day median is ~10.8% and the actions are new content ('size on what is new; reaction history moves p_up, not abs')
